package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type GetLearnerOverview struct {
	Profiles repository.StudentOnboardingRepository
	Mastery  repository.LearnerOverviewMasteryReader
	Journey  LearnerOverviewJourneyReader
}

type LearnerOverviewJourneyReader interface {
	GetLearningPath(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error)
	GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error)
	ListRecentLearningSessions(context.Context, string, int) ([]domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
}

func (useCase GetLearnerOverview) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.LearnerOverview, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Profiles == nil || useCase.Mastery == nil || useCase.Journey == nil {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("learner overview dependencies are required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var profile *domain.StudentOnboarding
	stored, err := useCase.Profiles.Get(ctx, studentID)
	if err == nil {
		profile = &stored
	} else if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, err
	}
	mastery, err := useCase.Mastery.ListRecentStudentTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, 20)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, err
	}
	var path *domain.StudentLearningPath
	storedPath, pathErr := useCase.Journey.GetLearningPath(ctx, studentID)
	if pathErr == nil {
		if len(storedPath.Items) > 50 {
			storedPath.Items = storedPath.Items[:50]
		}
		path = &storedPath
	} else if !errors.Is(pathErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, pathErr
	}
	var diagnostic *domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot
	storedDiagnostic, diagnosticErr := useCase.Journey.GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(ctx, studentID)
	if diagnosticErr == nil {
		if len(storedDiagnostic.Items) > 100 {
			storedDiagnostic.Items = storedDiagnostic.Items[:100]
		}
		diagnostic = &storedDiagnostic
	} else if !errors.Is(diagnosticErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, diagnosticErr
	}
	sessions, err := useCase.Journey.ListRecentLearningSessions(ctx, studentID, 5)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, err
	}
	overview, err := domain.NormalizeLearnerOverview(domain.LearnerOverview{
		StudentID: studentID, Version: domain.LearnerOverviewVersion,
		Onboarding: profile, RecentMastery: mastery, LearningPath: path,
		Diagnostic: diagnostic, RecentSessions: sessions,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.LearnerOverview{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return overview, nil
}
